All four now call the ONE shared read-path gate FITR in v5/code/_fit_gate.js — fitStored plus the loop R16 had written twice by hand — and every rung they set aside is printed with its reason. Adding FITR to the kit also exposed a hole in the lint itself: a kit documents and calls its own entry points, so a node that merely INLINED _fit_gate.js counted as gated; gate_lint now cuts the kit out before it asks, on the write side as well, which is why 'Ladder Plan' and 'Rank Keywords' are still listed here — they inline the gate and never call it on the way out. The rest are reads that do not advise from the keyword or the host — settings rows, publish matching, the e-mail/callback lookup, audit-site discovery — but they stay listed rather than excused, because the next person to make one of them advise should have to look at this file.
